notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
Our third Early Access update for Thigh Climbers is now live!

The WTCF wants to give you an inside look at the rigorous training that their climbers go through behind-the-scenes. This handful of minigames will test all the skills a successful climber needs in order to be the best! Train solo or face off against another player to win the Stocking of Skill!

Summary:
-added minigames to play solo or in head-to-head multiplayer
-improved UI in various menus
-additional bug fixes

Thigh Climbers is nearing its end in Early Access, so keep your eyes peeled and legs flexed for that announcement!

notes.title: Early Access Update 2
notes.content:
Our second Early Access update for Thigh Climbers is now live!

The Carnival is now open for business! Experience the terror and thrills of this exciting new climbing map, available for all climbing game modes! A carnival always needs a Ringmaster, and this one is no stranger to the spectacle that is Thigh Climbing. Seeking glory while stuck in the mortal plane, The Ringmaster is a new climber added to the WTCF competitive roster!

Speaking of glory, Steam achievements have now been enabled for the game! Do you have what it takes to be a Thigh Climbing champion AND unlock all of the achievements?

Summary:
-added new Carnival map to all game modes
-added The Ringmaster as a playable climber
-added Steam achievements
-additional bug fixes and improvements

Stay tuned for our future updates and the finished release of Thigh Climbers!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.content:
Our first major update for Thigh Climbers is here! We have improved many existing parts of the game including bug fixes, audio mixing, animation touch-ups, and more.

But we have also added new exciting parts of the game as well!

Some of the changes to the game include:
A new powerup system to all climbing modes with unique effects and strategies
We felt that the climbing matches needed just a little bit more to really feel exciting and unique from each other. As you climb up the pole in all match modes, there are now floating "sports drinks" kindly provided to the WTCF by Leg Juice Corp, Incorporated! Drinking each of these provide a unique effect anywhere from sending attacks at opponents, shocking them for a brutal cramp, or your climber becoming mostly incorporeal.

Voice-over for all playable characters
All 10 of our playable climbing characters now have full voice-over from a wonderful cast of professional voice-over artists! They have brought these characters to life by having wonderful lines when selected, taunting your opponent while attacking, and claiming victory at the top of the pole!

Improved animations for all climbing characters and announcers
Alongside the final voice-over for the climbers comes a new set of animations to match! Both climbers and the announcers have improved animations to include voice lines and more.


We expect to have another update out as soon as possible, so stay tuned for that as well! We hope you enjoy these changes we have made to Thigh Climbers and we can't wait to see you out on that pole!

Until next time,
Happy Leg Day!
